caption: The drawing depicts a three-legged metal object situated centrally on a neutral, beige background. The object consists of a circular base supported by three straight legs, giving it stability. On top of the base sits a cylindrical container with two distinct circular openings of different sizes. Attached to one side of the cylinder is a curved handle with an open end. Above the cylindrical structure, a long, thin rod extends upward, attached at its lower end to the main body, and ending in a small wavy flag-like element at the top. The overall color of the object is rendered in shades of black, gray, and dark tones, contrasted against the light background, which has a soft texture. The artist's signature, "Julius Bellamy," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Betty Lamp
